translation:
From the upper border of the pubic bone down to the upper border of the medial condyle (內輔), it is one chi and eight cun long. (The border of the bone is called the border (廉); the bone protruding beside the knee is called the condyle bone (輔骨); the inner is called the medial condyle, the outer the lateral condyle.)
From the upper border of the medial condyle down to its lower border, it is three and a half cun long.
